{{Top|leg}}
'''The Domestics''' were the seventh highest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]]. They were [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who worked in servant positions, serving members of the upper classes from the [[Gentry]] down to the [[Prosperines]].
